meta.title: dsh-gohome
meta.description: Shows a live countdown below the message composer for your own workday: remaining time, today's progress, ahead reminders (30 minutes by default, plus a final 5-minute pulse), and an overtime timer that starts when the workday ends. Weekends get their own label. Change the hours in place by clicking the row, or open Settings > dsh-gohome to save, adjust the reminder, and reset to defaults; changes apply immediately and are stored in this browser. The row reads only the local clock and sends nothing anywhere.
